evidence.locator: 1779 x 1805 px, north up; WFC3 Mg II 280 nm (blue), u 336 nm and [N II] 658 nm (red); released 1 July 2019. The original TIFF answered with 12,871,876 bytes, the file used. Its red channel lights the outer ejecta's gas dots; its scale (0.02294 arcsec a pixel) and the star's pixel are fitted against the 2014 F658N epoch.
